name: 会員記事の見出しと概要
prompt: Recreate the supplied Medium member-article header crop as a Japanese mobile editorial component. Final canvas: 1037 x 631 px, clean white background. Match the source's compact top badge, oversized two-line black headline, single gray summary line and muted reading-time/date line. At the upper-left, draw a white pill with a faint gray border and generous rounded corners, sized naturally for its Japanese label; place one small golden four-point sparkle at its left and the dark-gray label 「会員限定記事」. Below it, leave the source's broad vertical gap and set the heavy near-black headline at x≈6, on exactly two lines with this break: 「ChatGPTはあなたの脳を」 / 「蝕んでしまう…」. Use a bold Japanese system sans, about 84 px, tight source-like line spacing. Below the title, place one medium-gray subtitle 「手遅れになる前に止める方法」 on a single line, around 40 px. Near the bottom-left, place one muted gray metadata line 「5分で読める ・ 2025年4月30日」 around 36 px. Keep the hierarchy, left alignment, white space and typography scale faithful to the reference. No photographs, author avatar, buttons, other article content, device frame, or outer margins.
reviewNotes: レイアウトと二行見出しは原図に近いが、蝕んでしまう…は将来形寄りで原文の進行中の意味を弱める。第2版で蝕んでいる…に修正。
